construction.proof:
WHOLE PRISM ENVELOPE TO ANTIPRISM RING/SLOT COMPOSITION

Take a complete native source of canonical regular p-prisms of height h, with centers c_i and actual rational proper frames R_i. Retain every full source owner and source provenance. The target is canonical q-antiprism, full height H, whose two horizontal rings together project to a regular 2q-gon of radius R_q.

Let L=lcm(p,2q). The source facet normal angles form a p-grid and the projected target vertex angles a 2q-grid. Their differences form an L-grid. Choose the ONE canonical phase theta=arg(n_0)-arg(v_0)+pi/L (mod 2pi/L), so every source facet lies midway between two nearest points of the difference grid. Then max over all source normals/target vertices of cos angular difference is cos(pi/L). This proves the concentric whole projected target lies in alpha times the source base when alpha >= R_q*cos(pi/L)/a_p, where a_p is the source apothem. No optimized angle or frame approximation is inferred from a metric search.

For k complete target children per source, require alpha*h >= k*H. Put child (i,j) at alpha*c_i + R_i((j-(k-1)/2)*H*e3), j=0..k-1, with frame R_i Q_theta. Every child lies inside the same uniformly scaled complete parent; siblings have disjoint open axial intervals, and different parents inherit the original complete parent separation. The inverse decoder is (parent index i, axial slot j). Both axial signs of an arbitrary frame are respected by R_i e3; there is no common-axis hypothesis.

The source inequality proves this at the exact forced phase. A native implementation will choose a declared rational quaternion lift close to that single phase and recheck ALL actual source facet/target vertex inequalities with outward intervals, selecting a rational alpha no smaller than that actual containment requirement and k*H/h. All centers and all common cube wall costs are evaluated from the transformed actual child vertices. A common center/host dilation restores binary64 rounding; both inherited cross-parent and sibling separators and actual final native checks are mandatory.

First screen only actual retained/current prism parents with count n and k*n<=100 against current full public/private/pending AP cube gates. Preserve known-nominal certificate classification. The screen is only a proposal; full canonical containment and physical native decoding are required before claiming a gain. No antiprism record follows merely from a circular radius or volume inequality.
